objective: Produce structurally valid and evidence-aligned Coverage patches from the fixed v2 Audit ledger
hypothesis: A strict Patch evidence contract that permits named institutional processes but validates endpoint evidence and relation types will eliminate structure-blocked edges and improve answer-eligible repairs
evaluation_summary: The strict Patch evidence contract materially improved semantic yield: seven of thirteen new edges were accepted, three were pending, and three were rejected. However, the UBO repair remained structure-blocked and two known qualifier/source issues remained, so mandatory gates were not yet satisfied.

regressions.baseline: The new calculation process and classification result were semantically scoped
regressions.variant: Adding them to a card with an existing entry created no directed entry-process-exit path; P7D blocked all three edges before semantic review

next_action: Keep Audit and the strict contract fixed. Update only Patch construction: create a separate minimal card when supplementing would break graph shape, require required/need qualifiers in node labels and edges, and never attach further-investigation findings to an initial-investigation process.
